attchmntText: Sindhu Trade Links Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.Intimation under Regulation 33 & 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015/ Outcome of the Board Meeting.Sir,In compliance with regulation 30 & 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is hereby informed that, the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held on 14th November, 2026 has considered and approved the following matters:1. Considered and Approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) of the Company for the Quarter & Half Year ended on 30th September, 2026 alongwith Statement of Assets & Liabilities as on 30th September, 2026.2. Taken on record the Limited Review Report (Standalone & Consolidated) pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 submitted by the Statutory Auditors of the Company.The Meeting commenced at 12.00 P.M. and concluded at 01.00 P.M.
voiceSummary: Sindhu Trade Links Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during a Board meeting on 14th November 2026. The company reported a net profit after tax of 625.99 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the net profit after tax was 1,111.05 lakhs. The limited review report by statutory auditors contained no observations impacting the results. Revenue from operations stood at 9,289.13 lakhs for the quarter and 20,752.63 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.04 for the quarter and 0.07 for the half year. Total assets as of 30th September 2026 were 2,52,664.36 lakhs. The company operates in four segments: Transportation, Logistics and Construction; Oil, Lubricants and Spares; Finance and Investment; and Oil Drilling Operations.
